heading: I focus on practical ways to improve user experience and conversion.

cards.title: Content management
cards.body: I manage digital content across Amplience, Salesforce and SAP, from campaign pages to product and category content.

cards.title: Testing and analytics
cards.body: I use analytics, A/B testing and multivariate experiments to find what to change and check whether it worked.

cards.title: Working with teams
cards.body: I work with e‑commerce, SEO and brand marketing, plus design and development teams, on content and optimisation projects.

cards.title: Design background
cards.body: Before this, I led website design and brand projects at hellooodesign, and worked across web design, content management and IT.
